_comment: Model/engine registry for run_fal_workflow.py. 'workflows' maps a friendly workflow name to its JSON file, the auth it needs, and (for FalGenericAPI-based workflows) the swappable endpoints you can pass with --endpoint. Costs: 'local' = free (your GPU), 'fal' = Fal API credits (FAL_KEY), 'gemini' = Google Gemini credits (GEMINI_API_KEY).

render_kontext.purpose: Screenshot/sketch -> photoreal render via Flux Pro Kontext.

render_nanobanana_gemini.purpose: Screenshot/sketch -> render via official Google Nano Banana (Gemini key).
render_nanobanana_gemini.note: Current Google model IDs (as of 2026-07): gemini-3.1-flash-image = Nano Banana 2 (default), gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image = Nano Banana 2 Lite (cheaper), gemini-3-pro-image = Nano Banana Pro (top-tier), gemini-2.5-flash-image = original Nano Banana. Use the API model listing endpoint to see what your key can access.

render_generic_fal.purpose: Screenshot/sketch -> render via a swappable Fal edit endpoint.
render_generic_fal.note: Nano Banana edits are intentionally routed through the Gemini workflow, not here. Krea/Flux image-to-image entries (flux/krea/*) accept a source image plus a text prompt.

abstract_flux.purpose: Text-to-image abstract generation via Flux Dev.

abstract_generic_fal.purpose: Text-to-image abstract via a swappable Fal endpoint.

abstract_krea.purpose: Text-to-image via Krea 2 family and FLUX.1 Krea collab (aesthetic-focused).
abstract_krea.note: Krea 2 is strong on high prompt adherence, style transfer, and raw aesthetic. Large = best quality, Medium = balanced, Turbo = fastest. FLUX.1 Krea variants are the BFL collab with Krea. For image+text->image use the render_generic_fal workflow with fal-ai/flux/krea/image-to-image or fal-ai/flux/krea/redux.

abstract_multigen.purpose: Midjourney-style multi-generation: one prompt -> N image variations. Swap endpoint to test any text-to-image model with the same prompt.
abstract_multigen.note: The extra_arguments widget controls the batch count and resolution. Default is {"num_images": 4}. To also set explicit resolution: {"num_images": 4, "image_size": {"width": 2048, "height": 1152}}. All returned images are saved individually and shown together in the PreviewImage grid.

refine_nanobanana_chain.purpose: Iterative refinement chain (Gemini-style semantic inpainting). LoadImage -> NanoBanana#1 -> NanoBanana#2 -> NanoBanana#3 -> SaveImage. Each stage takes the previous stage's output plus a targeted prompt (e.g. 'change sky to sunset').
refine_nanobanana_chain.note: Mute (Ctrl+M) any stage nodes you want to skip. Each stage has its own prompt widget. Best for pre-planned multi-step refinement.

refine_from_output.purpose: Interactive Gemini-style refinement: pick any prior output from ComfyUI/output/ and refine with a new prompt. Run again after each refinement.
refine_from_output.note: Uses LoadImageOutput node - dropdown lists everything in ComfyUI/output/. Change the dropdown to the last render, change the prompt, click Run. Repeat.

refine_multi_engine_chain.purpose: Multi-engine 3-stage refinement chain: Flux Kontext -> any Fal /edit endpoint -> Nano Banana (Gemini). Lets you compare how different models handle each refinement step.
refine_multi_engine_chain.note: Any /edit-capable Fal endpoint works in Stage 2 (fal-ai/flux-2/edit, openai/gpt-image-2/edit, fal-ai/bytedance/seedream/v4.5/edit, fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/max, fal-ai/gemini-3-pro-image-preview/edit, etc.). Mute stages to skip them.

refine_from_output_generic.purpose: Interactive refinement via ANY Fal /edit endpoint (not just Nano Banana). Pick a prior output, choose the engine via the endpoint dropdown, prompt to refine.

abstract_i2i.purpose: Image-to-image abstract restyle via a swappable Fal edit endpoint.
abstract_i2i.note: Nano Banana edits are intentionally routed through the Gemini workflow, not here.

upscale_local.purpose: Free local GPU upscale (ESRGAN 4x) with optional resize to a target megapixel count. No API cost. DEFAULT upscaler.
upscale_local.note: ESRGAN multiplier is fixed by the .pth (4x-UltraSharp is always 4x). The ImageScaleToTotalPixels node after it lets you dial the final size by megapixels (default 8MP ~ 3760x2116 for 16:9). Mute it (Ctrl+M) to keep the raw 4x output. Swap the model_name widget for different ESRGAN styles.

upscale_local_to_target.purpose: Free local GPU upscale (ESRGAN 4x) then resize to an EXACT pixel width x height. For when you need a specific print/presentation size.
upscale_local_to_target.note: Default target 3840x2160 (4K UHD). Change width/height widgets on the ImageResizeKJv2 node. keep_proportion='resize' preserves aspect ratio; use 'stretch' to force exact dims, or 'pad' to letterbox.

upscale_clarity.purpose: Paid Fal Clarity upscaler (adds invented detail). Tuned defaults for cleaner output.
upscale_clarity.note: The POSITIVE prompt is hardcoded inside the fal-api node ('masterpiece, best quality, highres') and cannot be changed from the workflow - only the negative prompt is exposed. Resolution is set via upscale_factor (1.0-4.0), NOT width/height. Defaults tuned 2026-07: creativity=0.20 (was 0.35) and resemblance=0.75 (was 0.6) for less hallucinated detail / cleaner architectural output. Raise creativity toward 0.5 if you want more invented texture.

video_text_to_video.purpose: Text-to-video via Seedance 2.0 (Fal). Output is a video URL saved to a .txt file in output/.
video_text_to_video.note: Output is a URL, not a playable video in ComfyUI. Open the .txt in output/ and paste the URL into a browser, OR use video_preview_from_url to load the frames back into ComfyUI.

video_image_to_video.purpose: Image+text -> video via Seedance 2.0 (Fal). Feed a still image plus a motion/camera prompt. Output is a video URL.
video_image_to_video.note: Best all-round image-to-video. Duration 5s or 10s at 480p/720p. Prompt tips: describe camera motion ('camera slowly dollies forward'), atmospheric motion ('subtle wind through foliage'), or explicit action.

video_veo3_text.purpose: Text-to-video via Google Veo3 (Fal). Highest-quality current option, includes native audio generation.
video_veo3_text.note: 8-second fixed duration, audio generation on by default. Most expensive video option.

video_kling_image.purpose: Image+text -> video via Kling Pro 1.6 (Fal). Alternative to Seedance with different motion style.
video_kling_image.note: Cinematic camera motion, fluid natural movement. Optional tail_image lets you specify an end frame for controlled transitions.

video_generic_fal.purpose: Fal video via a swappable endpoint. Test any Kling / Seedance / Veo / Wan / Hailuo / Happy-Horse endpoint with the same graph.
video_generic_fal.note: Model-specific args go in extra_arguments as JSON, e.g. {"duration":"5","resolution":"720p"}. Output URL comes back on the raw_response_or_url slot.

video_preview_from_url.purpose: Utility: paste any generated video URL and preview its frames in ComfyUI as an image batch.
video_preview_from_url.note: Downloads the video and decodes it into a batch of frames. Use frame_load_cap and select_every_nth to control how many frames you extract.

3d_image_to_glb_trellis.purpose: Image -> 3D model (.glb) via Trellis 2 (Fal). Fast, general-purpose.
3d_image_to_glb_trellis.note: Output URL points to a .glb file. Download it and open in Blender / any 3D viewer. Best for simple objects and props.

3d_image_to_glb_meshy.purpose: Image -> 3D model via Meshy v6 (Fal). Higher-quality textured meshes.
3d_image_to_glb_meshy.note: Better for detailed / textured models. Higher cost than Trellis.

3d_image_to_glb_rodin.purpose: Image -> 3D model via Hyper3D Rodin v2.5 (Fal). Optimized for characters and organic shapes.
3d_image_to_glb_rodin.note: Strong on characters, sculpted forms, organic geometry.

3d_generic_fal.purpose: Fal 3D via a swappable endpoint. Test any image-to-3D model with the same graph.
3d_generic_fal.note: hunyuan_world is image-to-world/scene, not just a single object. Rest are image-to-object.

render_then_upscale.purpose: Render (Flux Pro Kontext, Fal) then upscale (local, free).

local_upscale_models.note: Place any of these in ComfyUI/models/upscale_models/. All are ~64MB and safe on a 12GB RTX 5070 (ComfyUI auto-tiles to avoid OOM). Change the model_name input in the local upscale workflows to match your filename.

options.4x-UltraSharp.pth: Best for architectural renders - crisp edges, clean surfaces.
